title: Finalizes Title X “Gag Rule”
description_short: HHS issued a final rule restructuring Title X and restricting providers that offer abortion referrals.
description_medium: On February 22, 2019, the Department of Health and Human Services finalized a rule restructuring Title X, the federal family-planning program. The rule restricted participating providers that offered abortion referrals, changing the conditions attached to federal family-planning funds. Opponents called the policy a “gag rule.” The available record does not detail the counseling or separation requirements.
organization_tags: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services
notes: Reason: The HHS page returned 403; the supplied summary establishes the rule and its effect on abortion referrals but not its counseling provisions, separation rules, or effective date. Proposed correction: add the final rule or a readable HHS summary for those details before completing the long description.
proposed_correction: Use the final rule text to specify its referral, counseling, and clinic-separation requirements.

title: Signs Asylum Cooperative Agreement with El Salvador
description_short: The U.S. signed an Asylum Cooperative Agreement with El Salvador, redirecting asylum seekers to apply there.
description_medium: On September 20, 2019, the United States signed an Asylum Cooperative Agreement with El Salvador. The Trump administration said the arrangement would let the United States transfer some asylum seekers to seek protection there instead of applying in the U.S. system. The available account does not set out eligibility rules, exceptions, or how transfers were carried out.
